svg.title: Traceworks and what it talks to
svg.desc: Traceworks is one process on the operator's machine. The operator starts runs; a package comes from a person, a model or someone else; CI or cron may start runs instead. On the machine: the package, the workspace that is checked, the home with runs, registers and the ledger, git and ssh-keygen, and Docker or Podman, which runs one container per step and a proxy beside an AI step. Outside the machine: a model provider, reached only through the proxy; an image registry, when images are built; and by the operator's choice a remote for the ledger and a target for a hook. What leaves the machine are the prompts and answers of AI steps.
